articles.summary: Texxon prices 1,900,000 shares at $5 for $9.5M; up to 285,000-share over-allotment option. Proceeds to Henan Polystyrene Factory and platform upgrades.
articles.title: Texxon Holding Limited Announces Pricing of $9.5 Million Initial Public Offering

articles.summary: Underwriters exercised the option for 285,000 shares at $5.00, bringing IPO gross proceeds to $10,925,000. Shares began Nasdaq trading as NPT on Oct 22, 2025.
articles.title: Texxon Holding Limited Announces Full Exercise of Underwriters’ Over-Allotment Option

articles.summary: Offering of 1,900,000 shares at $5.00 raised $9.5M, with a 285,000-share over‑allotment option. Proceeds to Henan polystyrene factory, platform, working capital.
articles.title: Texxon Holding Limited Announces Closing of $9.5 Million Initial Public Offering
